schema.description: JSON Schema of the block's data (pydantic model_json_schema).

CmsRedirectSourceEnum.description:
* `auto` - Written on a path change
* `manual` - Added by staff

ContentWarning.description: A non-blocking finding of this save or publish (not stored).

code.description:
form_unpublished: the embedded form exists but is not published (publishing the page will be refused); form_unverified: stapel-forms could not be asked, only the shape was checked.

* `form_unpublished` - form_unpublished
* `form_unverified` - form_unverified

field.description: Path of the field, e.g. blocks.2.data.form_id.

version.description: The version this editor read (optimistic lock).
The version this editor read (optimistic lock).

media.description: Described images of the media refs above (og_image, blocks), when the media service answered; a ref missing here renders from the ref alone.
Described images of the media refs above (cover, og_image, blocks), when the media service answered; a ref missing here renders from the ref alone.

ResolveMeta.description: Server facts a renderer needs next to the content.

embed_hosts.description: EMBED_HOSTS: the exact hosts an embed block may use (https only); the client-side embed allowlist should equal this.

og_image_url.description: Absolute URL of og_image's default rendition when the media service described it; null otherwise (render from the ref).

warnings.description: Findings of this request only; empty on reads.
Findings of this request only; empty on reads.

StapelError.description: Structured error returned by all Stapel API endpoints.

error.description: Human-readable fallback/debug message — not reliably English,

VariantMeta.description: One generated variant file (or the original) — mirrors ``VariantMeta``.

JWTBearerAuth.description: JWT access token in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header — the credential a native client sends. When the JWT cookie is also present, the cookie wins.

JWTCookieAuth.description: JWT token stored in cookie. Login via /auth/admin/ to get the cookie.
